rules.requirement: Issue and PR scope, acceptance, exclusions, evidence and compatibility notes
rules.review: Owner decides product value and scope; text presence is not approval

rules.requirement: Official Kotlin conventions with pinned ktlint defaults
rules.review: Contract DSL names, generated outputs and upstream material have separate contracts

rules.requirement: Selected detekt defaults, no finding baseline
rules.review: No type-resolution claim; intrinsic stubs and wire constants are not general smell rules

rules.requirement: Module/package dependency boundaries and named source files
rules.review: Semantic cohesion and meaningful names require review

rules.requirement: Pinned tooling, dependency locks and artifact verification
rules.review: New dependency necessity and upstream authenticity require review

rules.requirement: Actual SBF permissions, arithmetic, rollback and consumer evidence
rules.review: Passing cases are not an audit or arbitrary program proof

rules.requirement: Local links, version identity and runnable examples
rules.review: Prose accuracy and complete explanations require review

rules.requirement: Explicit artifact content, required notices and clean installation
rules.review: No generated keys, caches, website or compiler SDKs

rules.requirement: Every required result succeeds, PR required, no admin bypass
rules.review: Server settings must be audited; file presence alone is not enforcement

rules.requirement: Narrow explained exceptions changed through a separate policy PR
rules.review: Owner reviews rule changes; no tool can judge its own legitimacy
